channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: $12 Billion Farm Bailout Exposes Cost of Trump’s Trade War
item.description: The Southern California News Group (SCNG) published an editorial titled "$12 billion payout to farmers is a tariff-based disaster," saying a bailout announced earlier this month underscored the failure of the Trump administration's trade policies.

item.title: Jackie Shroff Pays Musical Tribute to Rajesh Khanna on His 83rd Birth Anniversary
item.description: On Rajesh Khanna’s 83rd birth anniversary on Monday, veteran actor Jackie Shroff paid a heartfelt tribute to the late star by dedicating the iconic number “Chala Jata Hoon” from the 1972 classic “Mere Jeevan Saathi”.

item.title: 13 killed, 98 injured after passenger train derails in Mexico
item.description: A passenger train carrying 241 passengers and nine crew members derailed on a bridge near Nizanda in southern Mexico on Sunday, leaving at least 13 people dead and 98 others injured, the Secretariat of the Navy said on social media.

item.title: Jamaat Alliance Rocks Bangladesh’s NCP
item.description: As the National Citizen Party (NCP) announced its decision to join a Jamaat-e-Islami-led alliance ahead of the Bangladesh general elections, triggering sharp internal dissent, party convenor Nahid Islam moved to clarify that the partnership was purely electoral and not based on any ideological convergence.

item.title: Tara Sutaria Shares Cosy Party Moments With Veer Pahariya and Orry
item.description: Actress Tara Sutaria gave fans a glimpse into a cosy night out as she shared pictures featuring her beau Veer Pahariya and B-Town’s bestie Orry.

item.title: Union Home Minister Amit Shah to Review BJP’s West Bengal Election Plans
item.description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah will begin a three-day visit to West Bengal from Monday night, during which he will review the Bharatiya Janata Party’s preparedness for the crucial Assembly elections scheduled in the state next year.

item.title: Dense fog leads to 128 flight cancellations at Delhi airport, trains delayed in several parts of country
item.description: Flight and train operations across several parts of the country were severely affected on Monday due to dense fog, with Delhi Airport witnessing large-scale disruptions, leaving thousands of passengers stranded.

item.title: Rajasthan to Welcome New Year with Cold Winds and Light Rain: IMD Forecast
item.description: The New Year in Rajasthan is likely to begin with cold winds and winter showers, as the India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a forecast for light rain in parts of the state.

item.title: Trump, Zelensky keep talks light as Ukraine peace negotiations advance
item.description: A mix of humor, gestures, and casual exchanges marked a high-stakes press appearance as US President Donald Trump and his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelenskyy sought to project ease and momentum at Mar-a-Lago, even as negotiations to end the war in Ukraine remained unresolved but close.

item.title: iPhone 16 becomes highest selling phone in India: Report
item.description: The report from Counterpoint Research said that Apple outpaced Android rivals in the same period. The research firm's data found the gap is striking as iPhone 15 also made to the top five best‑selling list.
